# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thomas Sowerby](../character/thomas-sowerby.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md)** — Mrs. Agatha Sowerby notices [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) dressed up and leaving town in a buggy on a busy afternoon, sparking her curiosity. Later that evening, she visits [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to discover the reason for his trip. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) explains that [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) has gone to the train station to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on their farm, leading [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to express her strong doubts and warnings.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) defends Obed's decision to adopt an orphan boy, while [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) warns her of potential disasters. [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) then departs to spread the news to her neighbors, expressing sympathy for whatever child comes to live with [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P30](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)_

## CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised

**[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md)** — [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) travels to the [Alder River](../codex/places.md#alder-river) station expecting to collect a boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), only to find an unexpected orphan girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to explain the mistake, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) takes her into his buggy for the drive home, pleasantly surprised to find her chatty company quite enjoyable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) drives the young orphan girl toward [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), listening as she talks endlessly and gives imaginative names to landmarks along the way. Upon arriving at the farm, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) dreads telling her that a mistake was made and that she is not expected to stay.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P46](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P69](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0069), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P77](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0077)_

## CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tranter](../character/tranter.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) are shocked that an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was sent instead of a boy. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) breaks down in tears upon realizing she is unwanted, but she settles in for tea and is put to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) discuss what to do, with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) insisting that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must be sent back to the asylum while [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) feels reluctant to do so.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters

**Frost Maiden, Grey Shutters, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tobias](../character/tobias.md), [Tranter](../character/tranter.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wakes up at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even bestowing names like [Frost Maiden](../codex/places.md#frost-maiden) on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the buggy to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) and settle Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

## CHAPTER V. Nell’s History

**[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — During the drive along the shore road, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chatters with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about her childhood, her orphaned background, and her previous caretakers. Her stories and gentle nature cause [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to feel a swell of sympathy for her difficult past.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind

**[Flora Odette](../character/flora-odette.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tranter](../character/tranter.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) to resolve the mix-up regarding the adopted child, encountering Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md) who offers to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Unwilling to leave the girl with Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) delays the decision and takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where she and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) ultimately agree to keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md)** — [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) up to bed and insists she fold her clothes and say her prayers. After learning [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) never prays, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) instructs her to improvise one, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to offer a unique prayer before settling into bed. Downstairs in the kitchen, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) informs [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) of her determination to provide [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a proper religious upbringing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) have decided to let her stay at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Excited and emotional, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) asks if she may call [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) her aunt, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) refuses and sends her to memorize the Lord's Prayer in her room.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) scolds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for her constant talking and sends her to her room to finish memorizing a prayer. Upstairs, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) finishes learning the prayer, imagines luxurious decorations in her room, and greets her surroundings from the window while thinking about potential friendships.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P46](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P48](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P54](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — Mrs. Agatha Sowerby visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and rudely mocks Nell's plain appearance and red hair. Enraged by the insult, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) flies into a violent temper and shouts at Mrs. Sowerby before storming off to her room. After Mrs. Sowerby leaves in offense, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) goes upstairs to lecture [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and demands that she apologize, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045)_

## CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) secretly visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her room and convinces her to apologize to Mrs. Sowerby. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) agrees, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accompanies her to Mrs. Sowerby's house, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) delivers a dramatic and humble apology. Mrs. Sowerby forgives her and offers her hope about her hair, and on the walk home, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her imaginative thoughts with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), expressing her joy at feeling at home at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)_

## CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) presents [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with three simple dresses and refuses her request for fashionable puffed sleeves, sending her off to study Sunday school materials. The next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone when [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) falls ill. Upon returning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) candidly recounts her experiences at church, including her dislike of her plain dress compared to the other girls' puffed sleeves and her impression of the service.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) reprimands [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for wearing flowers on her hat to church, then takes her to [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). The two young girls quickly bond and swear to be best friends forever before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home. Back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) gives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chocolates, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) admits to him that she is growing fond of the girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home late after visiting Isolde and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), excitedly sharing news with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic. While stitching patchwork, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chats endlessly about her imaginative games, and over the weekend she continues her eager anticipation of the picnic and admires Thirza's cherished amethyst brooch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Tobias](../character/tobias.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accuses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and locks her in her room after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists she didn't touch it. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) eventually fabricates a confession about dropping the brooch into the lake, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forbids her from going anyway. Later, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl and confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her fake story.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P14](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P42](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056)_

**[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tobias](../character/tobias.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers her missing amethyst brooch tangled in her black lace shawl and realizes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was innocent after all. She confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who admits she invented a false confession just so she could go to the picnic. Remorseful, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forgives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and sends her off to the picnic, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys tea, ice cream, and a boat ride on the lake.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P59](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P60](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Posy](../character/posy.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md), [Tillie Gammon](../character/tillie-gammon.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md), [Tillie Gammon](../character/tillie-gammon.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — Following Agatha's advice, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) decides not to force [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to school, allowing her to study at home instead. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses to forgive [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), she grows deeply attached to Isolde. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later finds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeping dramatically over the imagined future heartbreak of Isolde marrying and leaving her, which moves [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to rare, genuine laughter.

## CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md), [Tobias](../character/tobias.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets permission from [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to host Isolde for an afternoon tea while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is away in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). When Isolde arrives, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves her several glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial. Isolde becomes dizzy and ill from the drink, forcing her to leave prematurely before they can even have tea.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P7](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P29](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P36](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0036)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tobias](../character/tobias.md)** — Isolde leaves [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) unwell, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After learning Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) blames [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for getting Isolde drunk, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to clear up the mistake but is rebuffed. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then confronts Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) coldly turns her away.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P57](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0057), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P62](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0062)_

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Posy Pullen](../character/posy-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md)** — Isolde tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) they can no longer be friends on her mother's orders, and the two share an emotional farewell. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school, where her classmates welcome her back and she exchanges secret notes with Isolde. She commits herself to her studies, entering an intense academic rivalry with [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) while struggling with geometry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) spend a quiet evening at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracts croup while their parents are away. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) uses her experience to treat [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031)_

**[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md)** — After sleeping off her exhaustion, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learns from [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) apologized for the past misunderstanding and invited her over. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) excitedly rushes to visit Isolde, and upon returning home, she joyfully recounts their reconciled friendship and wonderful afternoon together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), [Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to let her stay at Isolde's and go to the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. After enjoying the concert and performances, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde return to the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) home late at night, where they inadvertently jump into bed on top of Isolde's visiting [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — After learning that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) was furious over the bed-jumping incident and planned to leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes full responsibility for the prank. She goes into the parlor to apologize directly to [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), successfully winning over the strict old woman with her honesty and charm. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) decides to stay, forgives Isolde, and develops a fond friendship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — In her room at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on her first year with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), who admits she does not regret keeping her. When [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the [Pembrokes](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confesses that she and Isolde invented ghosts in the nearby wood, making her terrified to cross it in the dark. Unmoved, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forces [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to walk through the woods to teach her a lesson, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reluctantly completes the frightening errand.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P30](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Posy Pullen](../character/posy-pullen.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional over Mr. Pidgeon's departure and discussing the upcoming arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md), and his wife. She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. However, because a severe cold ruined her sense of smell, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally flavored the cake with liniment instead of vanilla. ## CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.

## CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves

**[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Harris](../character/harris.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md)** — [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) notices how poorly [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dresses compared to her friends and decides to buy her a stylish new gown for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward attempt to shop by himself at [Samuel](../character/samuel.md) Lawson's store in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), he enlists Mrs. Sowerby's help to buy the fabric and sew the dress with fashionable puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives the gown at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is overwhelmed with joy and gratitude.

## CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses the club's creative endeavors with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. **[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) criticizes the girls' story-crafting club as foolish and distracting. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends it by discussing the morals of their tales and Mrs. Wace's influence, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) urges her to stop talking and finish the dishes.

## CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) expecting tea, only to find the kitchen cold and empty. She discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hiding in her room, distraught because she dyed her red hair green with a peddler's dye. After washing fails to remove the dye, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) cuts Nell's hair extremely short, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must face school with her cropped head.

## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends act out the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) drifting down the pond in a flat-bottomed boat. The boat begins leaking and sinks, forcing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) rescues her in his dory. Afterward, Hugh asks for Nell's friendship, but she stubbornly refuses him before reuniting with her frightened friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. Later, back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on her past mistakes and vows to give up her excessive romanticism, though [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) quietly encourages her to keep a little of it.

After [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) consents, Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) drives the girls to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), Aunt Lavinia's home, where [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) welcomes them warmly. The girls spend the week taking in the town's attractions, including attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and a concert.

Afterward, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) and [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) arrive to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). ## CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Elias Purdy MacKinnon](../character/elias-purdy-mackinnon.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), Frost Maiden, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tranter](../character/tranter.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learns that she has won the [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) wins the Medal. After graduation, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and reunites with Isolde, before learning from [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about Obed's failing health and concerns regarding their savings bank.

The Glory and the Dream P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034)_

## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Elias Purdy MacKinnon](../character/elias-purdy-mackinnon.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md)** — [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) collapses and dies after receiving news of the bank failure, plunging [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) into mourning. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) grieves with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and converses with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) about life carrying on despite her loss. As routine returns, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat on the porch about friends, future plans, and Thirza's past romance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P19](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)_

## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from the eye doctor with bad news that her vision is severely failing and she must avoid eye strain, prompting her to consider selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists on giving up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and teach locally so they can keep their home. Later, Mrs. Sowerby reveals that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) selflessly withdrew his application for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could teach there, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) thanks Hugh when she runs into him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md)** — Mrs. Sowerby remarks to [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) has mellowed. After visiting Obed's grave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) on the hill and thanks him for stepping aside for the school position, leading the two former foes to reconcile and become friends. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and later reflects contentedly at her window on her future path.
